name: Computer Use
description: Full control of the Mac through a signed Swift helper: Accessibility inspect/interact (preferred) and CGEvent mouse/keyboard + ScreenCaptureKit screenshots (last resort). Persistent daemon over a unix socket; TCC grants persist. Tool: Computer.

tool.name: Computer
tool.description: Control this Mac. Two layers, prefer the first: (1) Accessibility (structured, reliable) - inspect the UI tree and act on real elements by stable handle; (2) raw input (last resort) - synthesize mouse/keyboard at screen coordinates, plus screenshots, for canvas/Electron/web UIs where the AX tree is thin. Backed by a signed background helper (ComputerUseHelper.app) that holds the macOS Accessibility + Screen Recording permissions; it auto-starts on first use. Coordinates are logical points, top-left origin, spanning all displays (AX bbox values are in the same space - click an element's bbox center directly). Element handles like 'e7' come from snapshot/find/elementAtPoint/focused and stay valid until the UI changes (then you get a 409 'stale; re-snapshot'). Always check 'perms' first if anything returns a permission error.

action.description: What to do. ping: daemon liveness + permission status. perms: report (and with prompt:true, request) Accessibility/Screen/Input permissions and open the right Settings pane. apps: list running GUI apps {pid,bundleId,name,frontmost}. activate: bring an app frontmost (pid or bundleId) so keyboard input lands in it. windows: list an app's windows. snapshot: dump an app's accessibility tree as a flat element list (default) or nested tree, minting handles. find: search an app's tree by role/title/identifier/valueContains. elementAtPoint: hit-test the element at screen x,y. focused: the currently focused element. describe: full attribute/action dump for a handle. getValue/setValue: read/write an element's value (e.g. text field). perform: run an AX action (axAction) on a handle (AXPress, AXShowMenu, AXConfirm, AXIncrement, AXDecrement, AXRaise, AXCancel). mouse: move/click/doubleclick/rightclick/middleclick/down/up/drag/scroll at x,y. type: inject literal Unicode text into the focused field. key/keypress: press a key or combo (e.g. cmd+c). screenshot: capture the screen (or an area) to a PNG path or base64.

pid.description: Target app process id (for windows/snapshot/find). Omit to target the frontmost app.

bundleId.description: Target app bundle id, e.g. com.apple.TextEdit (alternative to pid). For windows/snapshot/find it selects the app. For type/key/keypress/mouse, supplying it (or pid) brings that app frontmost BEFORE the input so keystrokes/clicks land in it (recommended before typing). Omit to target the frontmost app.

maxDepth.description: snapshot: max tree depth to walk (default 20).

maxNodes.description: snapshot: cap on total emitted nodes (default 2000). Lower it to keep results small.

visibleOnly.description: snapshot: only include on-screen elements with a real frame (default true).

flatten.description: snapshot: true (default) returns a flat element list (token-cheap); false returns the nested tree.

role.description: find: match this AX role, e.g. AXButton, AXTextField, AXTextArea, AXMenuItem, AXCheckBox.

title.description: find: case-insensitive substring match against the element title/label.

identifier.description: find: exact match against the developer-set AXIdentifier (often absent).

valueContains.description: find: case-insensitive substring match against the element's value (text content).

el.description: An element handle like 'e7' from snapshot/find/elementAtPoint/focused. Required for describe/getValue/setValue/perform.

axAction.description: perform: the AX action name. Common: AXPress (click), AXShowMenu, AXConfirm, AXCancel, AXIncrement, AXDecrement, AXRaise.

value.description: setValue: the new value (usually a string for a text field).

op.description: mouse: which mouse operation. Defaults to move.

x.description: X coordinate (logical points, top-left origin). For mouse ops, elementAtPoint, and screenshot area.

clicks.description: mouse click: click count (1 single, 2 double, 3 triple).

steps.description: mouse drag: number of intermediate move steps (default 20, smoother = more).

text.description: type: the literal text to inject (layout-independent, supports emoji/CJK). Blocked when a secure/password field is focused.

combo.description: key: a chord like 'cmd+c', 'cmd+shift+4', 'ctrl+left'. Modifiers: cmd/command, shift, alt/option, ctrl/control, fn. Final token is the key.

key.description: keypress: a single key by name (return, tab, space, delete, escape, up/down/left/right, f1-f20, a-z, 0-9, etc), with optional modifiers[].

modifiers.description: keypress: modifier names to hold (cmd, shift, alt, ctrl, fn).

holdMs.description: key/keypress: ms to hold the key down before releasing (default 0).

mode.description: screenshot: 'screen' (whole display, default) or 'area' (a rect via x,y,w,h).

display.description: screenshot: display index (0 = main) for multi-monitor.

format.description: screenshot: 'path' (default, writes a PNG and returns its path) or 'base64' (inline PNG bytes).

outputDir.description: screenshot path mode: directory to write the PNG into.

prompt.description: perms: when true, fire the native permission prompts for anything missing and open the relevant System Settings pane.

pane.description: perms: which pane to also prompt for (input monitoring is optional/opt-in).
